paragraphs.text: A DSH Web plugin that keeps long answers and detailed prompts side by side with a dockable Composer.
DSH Composer Layout

Switch the controls layout.
A dockable Composer for DeepSeek Harness Web.

English · 简体中文
Features · Install · Usage · Changelog
Long answers and detailed prompts deserve their own space. Dock Composer to the right to reference a
n answer while shaping your next message; keep it at the bottom for compact conversations, or let Au
tomatic choose as the window changes. Models, permissions, sessions, tools, and token accounting con
tinue to use DSH's native behavior.
## Features
Three small layout changes make the reading-and-writing workflow easier to manage:
↔ Side-by-side drafting
Give the answer and draft separate vertical space. Drag the divider to set their balance; scroll a l

ong draft independently.
▥ Adaptive layout
Choose Bottom, Right, or Automatic. Narrow windows temporarily stack the panes; your Right preferenc

e returns when they fit again.
… Space-aware controls
In Bottom and Right layouts, overflowing third-party input controls fold into a … popup, keeping the
ir actions within reach.
**More everyday details:**
- **Per-session memory.** With “Remember this session layout” enabled, each session keeps its placem

ent and manually resized right-pane width in this browser.
- **Native editing.** The right-side edit
or fills the available input surface, including the blank area below a short draft, and retains nati

ve text selection.
- **Reachable pickers.** Slash and file-reference candidates stay inside the side

pane. Opening another Composer popup closes those candidates first.
- **Your preferred width.** Cho
ose a narrow, medium, or wide default right pane; fine-tune it with the divider.

## Use it in DSH
Set your default in **Settings → Built-in plugins → Composer Layout**, or use the rail at the conver
sation's right edge to switch between Bottom and Right. In Right layout, drag the divider to resize
e to switch between Bottom and Right. In Right layout, drag the divider to resize the Composer pane.
| Mode | When to use it | Behavior |

| **Bottom** | Short messages or a narrow window | DSH's compact bottom editor. |
| **Right** | Read
a long answer while drafting a detailed prompt | Two columns when they fit; temporary Bottom layout

when space runs out. |
| **Automatic** | Change window size often | Uses the conversation main area
's width-to-height ratio and the minimum width needed by both columns. |
The Automatic threshold is editable in the plugin settings. Enable session memory to keep each conve
rsation's layout and width. The Home/new-session screen retains DSH's native layout.
Transcript width in Right layout
Chat uses the available left-column width; the plugin divider adjusts its reading space. DSH's two n
ative transcript-width handles are hidden in Right layout. Returning to Bottom restores those handle
s and preserves DSH's saved width preference.
## Development
The changelog separates published work from development previews. Its scroll/overflow entries cover
native reading-position restoration, extra-control folding in Bottom, native menu surfaces and posit
ioning, original control sizing, and unclipped inline tooltips. Check the corresponding release entr
y before expecting those refinements in an npm installation.
